answer: Beacon-decay bond: each identity locks 70 credits at a beacon anchor. Each epoch a sparrow probe arrives at random; the agent must answer in 10 minutes, signing the hash with its quill. A missed, late, or copied sparrow reply decays the bond 8 credits; at zero the identity burns. The k-th probe costs 30+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes owe 3,027,000, 70,000 locked, for a 40,000 pool. A rented quill fails: one quill, one probe. Honest agents pay 30 once.
